title: OL-20261119-1: Bot-opened PRs stay blocked: required status check 'checks' is expected although the dispatched run passed
body:
**Owner:** merge-lane
**Trigger:** lane run with an open agent/* or bot PR whose dispatched checks run succeeded
**Done check:** grep:scripts/lane.sh::push_main
**Status:** closed

PRs 677 and 680 (opened with the workflow token) have a successful checks run on their head, yet the merge API answers Required status check checks is expected, while a PR opened by a user token merged once its pull_request-event run finished. The lane supersedes such PRs after about a day; the durable fix is to open them with the App token (so a pull_request event raises the required check) or to have the lane merge them through the App. Closing probe: open PRs in ultrastable trend to 0 without lane supersession.

**Vacuous:** 2026-11-19T08:34:23Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists


**Evidence:** closing probe passed (already built: the probe passed from filing and held for 35 passes over 1507 minutes (VACUOUS-CLOSE-1)): grep:scripts/lane.sh::push_main
